411   //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

420   assign align_trans.be      = be;
421   assign align_trans.wdata   = wdata;

423   assign align_trans.dbg     = trans.dbg;

427   // Transaction request generation
428   // OBI compatible (avoids combinatorial path from data_rvalid_i to data_req_o). Multiple trans_* transactions can be
429   // issued (and accepted) before a response (resp_*) is received.
430   assign trans_valid = (valid_0_i || xif_req) && (cnt_q < DEPTH);
431 
432   // LSU second stage is ready if it is not being used (i.e. no outstanding transfers, cnt_q = 0),
433   // or if it is being used and the awaited response arrives (resp_rvalid).
434   // XIF transactions bypass the pipeline, hence ready_1_i is not required for the second stage to
435   // be ready for XIF transactions.
436   assign ready_1_o   = ((cnt_q == 2'b00) ? 1'b1 : resp_valid) && ready_1_i;
437   assign xif_ready_1 = ((cnt_q == 2'b00) ? 1'b1 : resp_valid);
438 
439   // LSU second stage is valid when resp_valid (typically data_rvalid_i) is received. Both parts of a misaligned transfer will signal valid_1_o.
440   assign valid_1_o                          = resp_valid && valid_1_i && !xif_res_q;
441   assign xif_mem_result_if.mem_result_valid = last_q && resp_valid && xif_res_q; // todo: last_q or not?

443   // LSU EX stage readyness requires two criteria to be met:
444   //
445   // - A data request has been forwarded/accepted (trans_valid && trans_ready)
446   // - The LSU WB stage is available such that EX and WB can be updated in lock step
447   //
448   // Default (if there is not even a data request) LSU EX is signaled to be ready, else
449   // if there are no outstanding transactions the EX stage is ready again once the transaction
450   // request is accepted (at which time this load/store will move to the WB stage), else
451   // in case there is already at least one outstanding transaction (so WB is full) the EX
452   // and WB stage can only signal readiness in lock step.
453 
454   // Internal signal used in ctrl_update.
455   // Indicates that address phase in EX is complete.
456   // XIF request bypasses pipeline, ignores ready_0_i but requires xif_ready_1 instead.
457   assign done_0    = (
458                       !(valid_0_i || xif_req) ? 1'b1 :
459                       (cnt_q == 2'b00)        ? (trans_valid && trans_ready) :
460                       (cnt_q == 2'b01)        ? (trans_valid && trans_ready) :
461                       1'b1
462                      ) && (ready_0_i || (xif_req && xif_ready_1));
463 
464   // XIF request bypasses pipeline (does not assert valid_0_o) and takes precedence over regular
465   // requests, hence inhibits a concurrent request from EX stage
466   assign valid_0_o =  (
467                        (cnt_q == 2'b00) ? (trans_valid && trans_ready) :
468                        (cnt_q == 2'b01) ? (trans_valid && trans_ready) :
469                        1'b1
